reviews.title: Updates Keep making the Game worse!
reviews.text:
One State RP used to be a really good game, but the constant updates have become more frustrating than enjoyable. Almost every major update seems to introduce new bugs that can cause players to lose valuable experience, in-game money, items, or other progress. What makes it worse is how slow these issues are to get resolved, with little to no compensation or even an apology for what players have lost.
On top of that, it seems like every major update has a chance of items disappearing from your inventory. Reporting these issues has been made unnecessarily difficult, and when you finally do get help, it can feel almost accusatory, as if you're being treated like you're lying about what you had.
The game has always been heavily pay-to-play, but this latest update has taken it to another level. New players have virtually no chance of competing with established players without spending a significant amount of money.
Instead of constantly pushing new content and updates, the developers need to focus on fixing the existing problems and, more importantly, addressing the hackers who are actively ruining the game for legitimate players.
The game still has a lot of potential, but the developers need to start prioritizing stability, player support, fairness, and actually fixing the problems they create with these updates.
After playing this game for a long time, I've finally reached the point where the frustration outweighs the enjoyment. After this latest update, I'm deleting the game and moving on. It's disappointing to see a game that I once genuinely enjoyed get to this point.

reviews.title: When Poor Balance, Oversight, and Monetization Collide
reviews.text:
I have to be honest: while the graphics look great, this update has left me extremely frustrated with the direction of OneState, particularly when it comes to gangs.
I've played both faction and gang roles, so I'm not looking at this from only one side. But the imbalance has become impossible to ignore.
Faction members receive income every 30 minutes while on duty. Gang members don't. Instead, we're expected to grind through ridiculous task requirements just to progress. When I was in EMS, tasks could be 1, 3, 5 or 10 pills daily, 25 weekly, or 4 medkits. Now I'm looking at gang requirements of 300/500/1,000 sprays, 250/500/750 cargo, and spending as much as 1.5 MILLION Gang Tokens.
That's not balance. That's absurd.
And it gets worse. Before this update, I could use the regular in-game money I had already earned to purchase gang packs and obtain Gang Tokens. That option was available literally the day before this update. Now regular in-game money is essentially useless for acquiring the Gang Tokens needed for gang progression.
Instead, we're left with an excessive grind or premium currency purchased with real money.
Meanwhile, weapons cost tens of thousands of Gang Tokens, characters cost hundreds of thousands, vehicles can cost millions, spray cans cost Gang Tokens, and now you can lose 30+ spray cans just from dying.
Add in factions receiving additional protection zones while gang areas lose green zones, and I'm genuinely asking:
Does OneState even want gangs in this game anymore?
Because at this point, it doesn't feel like gangs are being balanced. It feels like we're being priced out.
What's even more frustrating is that OneState already created admins to govern RP and enforce the rules. If random violence, poor RP or harassment of factions is the problem, then USE THE SYSTEM YOU CREATED to address those players.
Why is the answer instead to progressively restrict an entire role?
I've already raised concerns about favoritism, unrealistic faction expectations and what I experienced as biased leadership and administration. Those problems matter. When faction gameplay starts feeling like a second job and players lose confidence that admins will address legitimate concerns impartially, some leave factions and move toward gang RP.
Restricting gangs doesn't fix that problem.
If you want less random violence and better RP, then give gangs something meaningful to RP: bank robberies, organized heists, criminal businesses and legitimate criminal ways to generate income. Hold people accountable when they violate RP rules instead of making the entire gang experience miserable.
And here's what makes the whole thing even more contradictory: OneState heavily advertises the gang/criminal lifestyle. That's part of what attracts people to the game.
So you're advertising gang life to bring players in while simultaneously making that same role increasingly difficult, restrictive and expensive to play?
Which one is it?
It honestly makes me question whether there is a clear long-term vision for this game or whether development is becoming reactive to whichever group complains the loudest.
And the monetization is becoming increasingly concerning.
There's a difference between making players want to spend money and creating an environment where players feel they have to spend hundreds of real dollars to reasonably enjoy a role. At some point you're not monetizing your players anymore—you're pricing them out.
I joined OneState because friends brought me into what looked like a fun RP game. Neither they nor I understood some of the policies surrounding purchases, refunds and potential account consequences at the time.
Now, after spending time in the game and watching these systems change, I'm seeing a pattern that concerns me far beyond simply disliking an update. When players can spend significant real money, have the usefulness or value of those purchases materially affected by later changes, and potentially face account consequences for seeking refunds, consumer-protection and potential legal questions naturally start entering the conversation.
I genuinely hope OneState looks at this before it reaches that point.
If gangs are no longer wanted, just say that. Stop advertising the lifestyle and create a separate environment for people who want that style of RP.
But don't advertise gangs, accept players' money to participate in that ecosystem, and then progressively make the role so expensive and exhausting that people feel forced out of it.
The graphics look great. The direction of the actual game does not.

reviews.title: Está demaciado fea y mal la nueva actualización
reviews.text:
Gente, sé que a pocos les gustó esta actualización, pero muchos estamos descontentos con los cambios. Parece que varias cosas fueron modificadas para dificultar el juego y obligar a gastar dinero.

Estos son algunos cambios:

* ❌ Los paquetes de pandilla ya no dan calaveritas.
* 💰 Curarse en el hospital es mucho más caro.
* 🚕 Ya no hay tareas de trabajos como taxi, mecánico, mensajería, etc.
* 🚗 Los reparadores de coches ya no los dejan al 100%.
* 💊 Las curas  recuperan muy poco y son muy caras.
* 🌙 Las noches son demasiado oscuras.
* 🚘 Bajaron los precios de los coches en liquidación.
* 🪖 Los chalecos de los militares aguantan muchísimo más; parecen inmortales.
* 💵 Los chalecos que venden son demasiado caros.
* ⚡ Te cansas más rápido y las bebidas energéticas duran apenas unos segundos y son caras.
* 🪂 El daño por caída es exagerado.
* te quitan una cantidad exagerada de latas por morir 

El problema es que, si la gente supiera rolear, algunos cambios podrían tener sentido. Pero muchos lo ven como un shooter: te ven y te matan. Con los precios elevados, jugar se vuelve difícil y frustrante.

Por eso, recomiendo a quienes no están de acuerdo hacer una protesta pacífica:

👉 No entrar al juego por un tiempo.
👉 No comprar pases ni gastar dinero en el juego.
👉 Ir a las páginas oficiales, como TikTok, Facebook y demás redes, y dejar nuestras quejas con respeto.

Si todos nos unimos y hacemos escuchar nuestra voz, los desarrolladores se darán cuenta de que la comunidad no está de acuerdo con estos cambios.

No se trata de destruir el juego ni atacar a los desarrolladores. Se trata de demostrar que **somos los jugadores quienes mantenemos vivo el juego y nuestra opinión también importa.**

Si estamos unidos, tenemos mucha más fuerza. 💪🔥

The whole game has basically become pay-to-win. Only players who have money and are willing to spend it can actually enjoy the game. And honestly, even the players who do spend money can barely keep up anymore.

I really hope you reconsider this update and fix these issues. Otherwise, I’m going to delete the game and switch to another one.

The new content feels copied instead of original, with nothing that makes this update exciting. I deleted the game, and clearly I’m not the only one frustrated.

reviews.title: بصراحة، من بعد التحديثات الأخيرة، صار واضح أن اهتمامك بالربح أصبح أكبر من اهتمامك بتطوير اللعبة وتحس
reviews.text:
بصراحة، من بعد التحديثات الأخيرة، صار واضح أن اهتمامك بالربح أصبح أكبر من اهتمامك بتطوير اللعبة وتحسين تجربة اللاعبين.

كل تحديث تقريبًا نشوف تركيز أكبر على الأشياء المدفوعة وطرق سحب المال من اللاعبين، بينما الإضافات الحقيقية والمحتوى الجديد للخريطة ما عادت بالمستوى اللي يتوقعه اللاعبون. اللعبة اللي كنا نحبها ونقضي فيها ساعات، بدأت تتحول إلى لعبة مادية بشكل مبالغ فيه، وهذا الشيء دفع كثير من اللاعبين إلى تركها والابتعاد عنها.

إذا فعلًا تريد تحافظ على لاعبين One State وتخلي اللعبة تستمر وتكبر، حاول تركز على حل المشاكل والـGlitches والأخطاء، وتحسين الأداء، وإضافة محتوى جديد ومميز بدل ما يكون كل التركيز على المال.

اللاعب مو مجرد وسيلة للربح. اللاعب هو السبب اللي خلّى اللعبة تستمر وتنجح من الأساس.

وهذا الكلام مو رأيي وحدي، وإنما إحساس وملاحظة عند عدد كبير من لاعبين One State. نريد نشوف اهتمام حقيقي باللعبة وبالمجتمع، لأن استمرار اللعبة يعتمد على رضا اللاعبين، مو فقط على مقدار الأموال اللي يتم تحقيقها منهم.

reviews.title: SOME ADMINS OF THE GAME ARE NOT FAIR
reviews.text: I love this game, and this was the first time I will ever get banned, it’s pained me a lot but I will let it slide. On GLENDALE AFR SERVER, There was a situation that happened yesterday, I was at VM to sell a car. One guy walks to me that he likes my car, he ask how much I want to sell it to which I told him the price. I however RP with him and told him to enter inside the car for me to pass him the key. He did, and I passed him the key for him to test drive the car, immediately he drove just 1 meter out of the VM gate, one player tased him out of the car and killed him for no RP reason. I see that as bullying and it’s against the server Rules, but wasn’t expecting that from him in the first place so I don’t have my cam on. I ran from where I was standing to meet the guy and told him that’s never a way to RP with anyone in the game. This guy trash talked to me, frustrated me to which my human self got into me and I replied him back. He went ahead to his admin friend to drop my cam and the Admin banned me for 24hrs. The guy was telling me he’s been doing it for many people, I believe people like him and his admin friends will make the game never to be fun for people who are ready to RP well in this PRESTIGIOUS GAME. I want you all DEV to help us look into this type of situations very well.
